Hitting cancel to discharge can help with sucking the sitting water out. It was also rather loud when running and extremely loud when discharging into the pipe under my kitchen sink, much louder discharging than the old Maytag that came with my house. (Having more drain hose looped down under the sink seems to help reduce the discharge noise on other dishwashers, so it probably would do the same for this one.) It was also easy to accidentally turn on when standing in front of it and working on the counter. It plays a little tune though so at least you know you accidentally turned it on. It was easy to open and use otherwise, so I am disappointed that I had to return it because of the horrible installation.

Sentence (English): I have now had this DW for just over a month.
Comments (English): [ LOVE THIS DW ] || ---------------- || I have now had this DW for just over a month. I can't remember the last time I loved an appliance more. This DW is solidly built. The stainless steel interior will last and retain its clean look, both on the outside and inside. I had not anticipated loving the silverware tray up at the top, but gosh! It's a really nice feature. The racks are good sized for all my needs. Even the big 7-qt Le Creuset fits in easily on the bottom. It is so quiet I have often wondered if it was actually on - but it is! The dishes all come out sparkling. I use the Normal setting most often. Plasticware tends to not always be dry but that doesn't really bother me. I understand that there are other settings that alleviate that problem. I'm already mourning its loss when I return to the West Coast in 2 years. I guess I'll just have to get another one once I'm there!

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher from Costco and love it.
Comments (English): [ Love It! ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher from Costco and love it. I went from a high-end Fisher Paykel drawer system that was prone to issues to this single door dishwasher. I love the 3rd rack! It holds so many useful items that would normally fall through the racks of a regular dishwasher and need to be washed by hand, no longer! I did want it for my sports bottles because of the special bottle jets, but it is too small for the majority of the bottles I use but I find many other dishes and cups to put on that rack. I also wash all of my pots and pans and KitchenAid mixer bowls on the bottom rack which I have never done before and now wash soome pan or cutting board every cycle. This has truly helped with cleanup. I also have some large pasta bowls that I use every night for salad and they never fit in my previous dishwasher, but no problem for this one. There is definitely a learning curve on how to load it and how best to use the movable racks and tines, but once you realize what fits best for your needs, it is perfect. I run it on the Pro cycle wash and dry, which takes a crazy 2 hours 45 minutes to go through the cycle, but everything comes out clean and dry (including Tupperware). There is a huge amount of space in this dishwasher! I look forward to seeing what things I can wash in there every day! The fingerprint free stainless outside is fantastic, I used to have to wipe my stainless down everyday. I would say the only downside is the operation buttons are annoying because they are on the top panel inside the machine, so I hit them every day when I am loading it which causes it to beep and begin a countdown to start the dishwasher, but I just cancel it and continue loading. It is an annoying problem and the company should put a lock on the button panel until you are ready to run the dishwasher. Costco only offers the model with the bar, which I didn't initally want because it wouldn't match all of my Wolf/subzero appliances, but I have found it isn't a problem. It blends in nicely and the bar doesn't protrude that far out. The dishwasher is very quiet. Overall, I am extremely satisfied with this dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Solid, Dependable DW - No Bells and Whistles ] || ---------------- || Just purchased the Bosch 100 with top controls. Very well packaged with styrofoam on the bottom and corners reinforced with wood 1x2s. If found it to be easy to install with no complexities. Sentence (English): 1 Advantages: The dishwasher is really one of the necessary appliances in the kitchen.
Comments (English): 1 Advantages: The dishwasher is really one of the necessary appliances in the kitchen. It cleans cleanly and saves time. General tableware, especially porcelain and stainless steel, wash out very well. I have never used rinse aid. The effect of washing the glass is mediocre, and the appearance is not shiny, which is probably the reason why I did not use rinse aid. Heavy oil stains, such as the cracks on the edge of the pot cover, cannot be completely cleaned in one wash. I usually use light oil and daily two functions. The smart function is very practical. It can be controlled remotely with Haier’s smart home. It can also know the number of times of washing dishes, time spent, etc., which is convenient for statistics. It is convenient and practical to automatically open the door after washing. After washing in the morning, the tableware is already dry when cooking at noon. Personally, I feel that these four functions are enough for daily use. These four functions can be used as backup items when choosing a dishwasher. 2 Disadvantages: the sound is relatively loud when washing, the workmanship is not fine, the left side of the door is not flush with the upper side, the left side and the box body are not the same up and down, the top width is narrow, and the top side is high and low with the left side of the box body. Every time I wash it, there is a smell. At first I thought it was dishwashing powder, but after changing the dishwashing powder, it still remains the same. It is probably the smell of stainless steel in the dishwasher after high temperature.
Comments (Original): 1优点:洗碗机真是厨房里必备的电器之一，洗的干净，又省时间。一般的餐具尤其是瓷制和不锈钢的洗出来的效果非常好。我一直没有用亮碟剂，玻璃洗完的效果一般，外表没有亮晶晶的，估计是没用亮碟剂的原因。比较重的油渍，比如锅盖的边缘缝隙里 ，一次洗不能完全干净。我常用轻油和日常两个功能。智能功能非常实用，用海尔的智家可以远程控制，里面还可以了解到洗碗的次数，耗费时间等，便于统计。洗完后自动开门方便实用，上午洗完，中午做饭的时候餐具已经干了。个人感觉有这四个功能日常用就足够了，选洗碗机时这四个功能可以作为比备项。 2缺点:洗的时候声音比较大，做工不精细，门的左边和上边不平齐，左边和箱体不是上下一样齐上宽下窄，上边和箱体左高又低。每次洗完有股味道，一开始以为是洗碗块的，后来换了洗碗粉还是一样，估计是洗碗机里不锈钢经过高温的味道。

Sentence (English): Hello?
Comments (English): Hello? This is Cherry Mom. I will start the review of the experience group! Please note that this is an extremely subjective review^-^ Reason for selection My mom volunteers to serve lunch every weekend, and I thought washing the dishes would be difficult, so I chose a dishwasher as a gift. Delivery I ordered it on Tuesday afternoon and received it on Wednesday! Rocket Jjang packaging It came packaged in a very large box with Styrofoam. Product This product is a no-installation, 3-person dishwasher that does not require drilling. Review A lot of dishwashers are used these days. Usually, we use dishwashers that are drilled and installed by an installer. However, if the space to place the dishwasher is narrow and the only empty space is far from the sink, I recommend this product. This product is no-installation, so there is no need to drill a hole in the sink, and since it is for 3 people, it has the advantage of being able to be installed in narrow spaces. It may seem like the inside space will be small because it is for 3 people, but it can hold more dishes than you think. And there are 5 modes, so you can use them according to the situation. It is explained in detail in the user manual, and even the time and temperature are listed. The only slightly inconvenient thing is that although it is convenient because it is no-perforation, it can be a hassle to have to fill the water yourself. Installation is not difficult at all! Just connect the electricity and drain hose and turn the screw to finish. I will add a review later. I recommend it because it has various modes and is not too big so it can fit in tight spaces. If my review was helpful in your purchasing decision, please click [Helpful] ^-^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I like washing dishes, so I didn't really feel the need for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Improve your quality of life Save your time A dishwasher with good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I like washing dishes, so I didn't really feel the need for a dishwasher. My husband hates washing dishes, so I did it all myself, and although we are a double income household, I was gradually getting tired of housework. I heard a lot of people around me say that dishwashers are really good, so I decided to try using a dishwasher and chose the Media 2-3 person dishwasher. To tell you the conclusion first, even I, who didn't particularly hate washing dishes, fell in love with the dishwasher because it was able to wash dishes more cleanly. It usually takes about 20-30 minutes to wash dishes once, but since I wash dishes twice a day, I can save several hours a week. It couldn't be better because I can have more time for myself! You have to buy dishwasher detergent separately, but since the recommended capacity is 6g, you can buy a product that matches that! It is very suitable for a 2-3 person household, and the composition is also rich. It was good that it was installed with an additional stand for putting milk bottles and small bowls. <Installation method> It was easy for a woman to install it alone, but it was heavier than I thought, so it was hard to put it on the sink, but the installation after that was easy. First, after taking out all the contents inside, connect the drain hose to the drain part at the back. Since a clipper is included to fix the drain hose so that it doesn't fall out, tighten it as tightly as possible! You can choose to install it by selecting manual or automatic water supply, but I searched a lot because it wasn't mentioned in the manual. For manual water supply, you can put the water tray and water tank included together into the water supply hole located at the top. <Automatic water supply installation method> Since the automatic water supply hose is also included, you can use the automatic water supply by connecting it like a washing machine. In my house, we used to use a water purifier, but we stopped using it, so the remaining water purifier hose was connected to the sink faucet. If you connect the water purifier connection part (usually 15A, 6mm - 21mm male thread) to that part, you can install the automatic water supply installation by yourself. The part has not arrived yet, but if you search the Internet, there are many people who use media dishwashers, so there are various ways to install the automatic water supply, so I think you can install it in the right way. ***Update*** The automatic water supply installation was successful! It works very well, and it saves a lot of time and improves the quality of life because it supplies water quickly compared to manually filling it with a water tank! Not only would I recommend this to friends, I would buy it again.

Comments (English): [ Functions well, quiet operation ] || ---------------- || Though this is pricey for the features listed it delivers very good cleaning results. The racks have minimal adjustments but still work well for our family of three using cooked from scratch meals. Most pots and pans need hand washing due to size limits. Manual cleaning of filter is challenging on the cylindrical screen - use a toothbrush - but the assembly is easy to remove and replace. Good design of soap dispenser prevents accidentally blocking it when loading the dishwasher. A long cycle takes about 2 hours. Open the door after cycle completes and let dishes dry before taking them out, no drying cycle present. Dishes and flatware must be well scraped before loading, dried food like egg yolk often isn't cleaned completely.A big plus for me is the leak-proof design of an under-tub.This would be a 5 star unit if racks were more adjustable and a drying cycle present. I can recommend it.

They will not fit in the washer regularly (in vertically) without knocking off the center sprayer. I've tried with the center rack at the highest position, it still doesn't fit anything. Sentence (English): This review covers both the machine, the Bosch website and the instruction that came with the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good and bad ] || ---------------- || This review covers both the machine, the Bosch website and the instrctions that came with the dishwasher. On the whole it works well with a couple of exceptions 1. I have 9 inch stem wine glasses. Not unusual, I think. There is no way to fit them into the middle rack, even at its lowest setting, which is where they are supposed to go. The base of the glasses touch the upper rack. 2. Page 33 of the manual. Switching the appliance on. Below that it says. Press the On/Off button 1. The display of the last selected wash cycle flashes. This wash cycle remains selected if no other wash cycle button 2 is pressed. That statement is garbage. It reverts to Auto. Every time. I have confirmed this with with Bosch support. 3. On page 12 for the last entry "Auto door open" It says "Door automatically opens at the end of every cycle except rinse. Same words used on page 37." Garbage. It only works if the Auto Air Option has been selected. I have also confirmed this with with Bosch support. 4. We always select Speed60. This always defaults to a time of 1:24 (assuming Auto Air is turned off). I asked Bosch Support why it was not 1:00. I was told the sensor decides based on the items in the machine. Garbage. Whether the machine is empty or full it always shows 1:24. So that was wrong. And if you add Auto Air it adds another hour to the cycle. So I pay for an hour's electricity if I want the door to open automatically.

The whole machine is full of plastic, and the inner tank is actually plastic. There are not many stainless steel inner tanks on the market, right? Using plastic has no other benefits except cutting corners, and it is hard to say whether there are harmful substances in plastic after being heated. 3. The workmanship is poor. I read the comments before saying that the seams were poorly made. I thought it was an exception, but now it doesn't seem to be the case. Comments (Original): 如果不是因为占地空间小，大概率不会选这个，毕竟在台式洗碗机的范围内它的竞争力还是挺靠前的，说一下感受。1，清洗效果还算可以。空间在台式机里面算大的，当然那种可台可嵌的除外。2，整机满满的塑料感，内胆居然也是塑料的，市面上不用不锈钢内胆的没几家吧？用塑料的除了偷工减料没别的好处，而且塑料受热以后有没有有害物质还不好说。3，做工差，之前看评论有说接缝做工差的，我以为是个例，但现在看来不是。图3的位置，每次洗完都会翘起来需要摁一下还原，伴随着咯嘣的异响。4，安装师傅态度很好，但是一些小聪明的做法让我不能认同，在外谋生都不易，但应坚持原则底线。

Sentence (English): Another Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A class of its own ] || ---------------- || Another Bosch dishwasher. The previous one served for 13 years and went to someone else in full working order. After buying this model for a new kitchen, I can fully recommend it. Well-made, energy-efficient, quiet - I have it in the kitchenette connected to the living room and it does not interfere during work. It dries well, is ergonomic, has an adjustable cutlery drawer which is quite a good solution. A large display, which I missed before, and in line with the times, remotely controlled. Everything is a plus, I found no minuses. To sum up - I am very satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ Klasa sama w sobie ] || ---------------- || Kolejna zmywarka firmy Bosh. Wcześniejsza służyła 13 lat i w pełni sprawna powędrowała do kogoś innego. Po zakupie tego modelu do nowej kuchni mogę w pełni ją polecić. Dobrze wykonana, energooszczędna, cicha - mam ją w aneksie kuchennym połączonym z salonem i nie przeszkadza podczas pracy. Suszy dobrze, ergonomiczna, szuflada na sztućce regulowana co jest całkiem dobrym rozwiązaniem. Duży wyświetlacz czego mi wcześniej brakowało i zgodnie z duchem czasu zdalnie sterowana. Wszystko na plus, minusów nie znalazłem.  Podsumowując - jestem bardzo zadowolony.

Sentence (English): It has brought two years of frustration and disappointment.
Comments (English): [ This is the worst dishwasher I've ever owned ] || ---------------- || It has brought two years of frustration and disappointment. Biggest disclaimer right off the bat: You cannot effectively wash large dishes or pans. They will not fit in the washer regularly (in vertically) without knocking off the center sprayer. I've tried with the center rack at the highest position, it still doesn't fit anything. Instead, you need to lean them awkwardly, making it so you can only wash one large pot or pan max per load and it severely limits what else can fit. The main culprit is the third rack. The marketing worked on us, but that stupid third rack only makes the entire thing useless. Due to the center racking adjustment gimmick, the center sprayer is dynamic and attaches to the rack with two snap clips that constantly detach, causing the dishes to not get clean and requiring you to reattach each run. The cleaning quality is meh, the dishwasher is quiet, but it's deficiencies are so loud that you will find yourself screaming at it and cursing it's name. I wish we never got rid of our KitchenAid because it cleaned a bit better, wasn't much louder, and fit all of our large dishes no problem.

Sentence (English): Replaced a 20 year old Jenn Air that probably cost twice as much.
Comments (English): [ The absolute best. And NO brand badges or handles ] || ---------------- || Replaced a 20 year old Jenn Air that probably cost twice as much. We almost went Bosch but the racks felt like dragging metal on concrete and we loved the ball bearing racks on the LG. I've been using this dishwasher nightly for 2 weeks and am ready to review. TL;Dr - It's fantastic! We use equate brand liquid dishwasher detergent and dry aid. So no frills. I run auto > steam > dry boost > night dry options. Wash quality: Dishes come out spotless and most importantly, bone DRY. EVEN TUPPERWARE. This has never been possible before with our Jenn Air. Bonus: The 3rd rack is useful for big knives, small lids, and some other utensils. Size: This thing is huge! But it sticks out less than 1/2 and inch from the counter. The metal prongs are extremely sturdy and easily folded to make room for other size dishes. I like the LG's more standardized layout vs the Bosch 800 which felt like pure chaos. Finish: We love the non finger print stainless. For those concerned it looks JUST LIKE STAINLESS and not a cheap sticker. Matches our unbranded Samsung fridge and Jenn Air appliances 100%. Lighting: We love the interior lights. It's a little extra touch. Noise: Sound? What sound. This baby is so quiet I can't even hear it while standing in the same room. Drying: The night dry option with the fan that blows moisture out of the interior throughout the night is GENIUS for people who aren't there to immediately put away clean dishes. Summary:For the price I think this is the Bentley of dishwashers and I'm very happy with our purchase. It's also easy to install yourself. You only need a new dishwasher water line. Everything else is in the box.

Comments (English): [ The quietness when running is amazing!  ] || ---------------- || We purchased our dishwasher at our local Bray and Scarff store and arranged for installation and haul away of our old unit. From the first load of dishes, it has run so quietly that it is quite easy to forget that it is on. We have the stainless steel tub, adjustable height middle rack with bottle washer tines, and a top rack silverware holder. We suggest NOT placing knives flat on the top rack. They will not get clean and will dry with water spots. Keep knife blades vertical in the top rack. If the blade is too wide to allow the rack to be closed, open a flap in the silverware basket on the bottom rack and stand the knife inside so it does not block the path of the sprayer arm. We learn best practices as we go to get spot-free clean loads. We wait about 2 days to get a full load inside the machine before washing. Dried-on food and drink have not been an issue at all!

Grant it, it's not a lot but over time it builds up and I have to get a towel to soak up the excess water. Water should not build up like that after any cycle. It breeds bacteria from the dirty water and it leaves the dishwasher smelling horrible. I would think at least this product should have a feature that drains it out. Other than that, it does what it is designed to do.

Sentence (English): My second cycle, emptied the clean dishes, filled dishwasher, added soap, closed door, pushed start and walked away.
Comments (English): [ Couple things I would change ] || ---------------- || My second cycle, emptied the clean dishes, filled dishwasher, added soap, closed door, pushed start and walked away. Came back later and dishes were not washed. Closed the door again and pushed start, the lights came on showing what cycle I was using, 30 seconds later, they shut off. Checked all the documentation and on page 4 of the user guide it says this: If your Start/Resume button is located on front of door: push door firmly closed. The door latches automatically. Select the wash cycle, options, and press START/RESUME or press START/ RESUME to repeat the same cycle and options as in previous wash cycle. Since I am repeating the same cycle, I should be able to press start to wash the next load of dishes. The only way to wash dishes using the same settings as the last cycle is to press the start button twice. Who came up with this? It's not going to kill me to do this but I am annoyed because it makes no sense. The only other issue I have is the silverware basket does not have a lid on at least one and but better on a couple of the slots to keep small & light items inside. But I have a fix for that, I kept the last 2 baskets from my previous 2 Whirlpool dishwashers. The last one had the basket attached to the door and it was tiny so I kept the basket from the previous dishwasher. And I used both most of the time. Not thrilled with the filters that need to be removed and rinsed. Never had to do this before and since I am not thrilled with it, my dishes are very clean before they go into the dishwasher, it is basically just sterilizing my dishes. As long as this dishwasher does not have to be replaced for a long time, I will be happy with it but because of the silverware tray and the filters, I would not feel comfortable recommending it.

Came back later and dishes were not washed. Closed the door again and pushed start, the lights came on showing what cycle I was using, 30 seconds later, they shut off. Checked all the documentation and on page 4 of the user guide it says this: If your Start/Resume button is located on front of door: push door firmly closed. The door latches automatically. Since I am repeating the same cycle, I should be able to press start to wash the next load of dishes. The only way to wash dishes using the same settings as the last cycle is to press the start button twice. Who came up with this? It's not going to kill me to do this but I am annoyed because it makes no sense. The only other issue I have is the silverware basket does not have a lid on at least one and but better on a couple of the slots to keep small & light items inside. But I have a fix for that, I kept the last 2 baskets from my previous 2 Whirlpool dishwashers. The last one had the basket attached to the door and it was tiny so I kept the basket from the previous dishwasher. And I used both most of the time. Not thrilled with the filters that need to be removed and rinsed. Never had to do this before and since I am not thrilled with it, my dishes are very clean before they go into the dishwasher, it is basically just sterilizing my dishes. As long as this dishwasher does not have to be replaced for a long time, I will be happy with it but because of the silverware tray and the filters, I would not feel comfortable recommending it.

Costco needs to be informing people that even though they advertise free installation and delivery, you may not get your dishwasher installed and possibly will not get your dishwasher all together.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher in August 2022 and within months of use, the dishwasher just sometimes stops working.
Comments (English): [ Intermittently dies ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher in August 2022 and within months of use, the dishwasher just sometimes stops working. It goes into the panel flashing mode where nothing helps (including the lean into the door trick) except to reset the circuit breaker. Once we put the circuit back on, it's a roll of the dice as to if the panel will be responsive on or not. Once we do get the dishwasher to turn on (i.e. pressing on the power button actually works), it runs OK for about a couple of days before the panel starts flashing again (which sometimes happens in the middle of the cycle). It's been a real disappointment.

Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for just over a month and I'm still amazed at the silence when it's running.
Comments (English): [ Can't believe how quiet this dishwasher is! ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for just over a month and I'm still amazed at the silence when it's running. The dishwasher is great - this is the 3rd dishwasher I've owned and my first KitchenAid. I was drawn to this brand because I chose the KitchenAid range hood after doing a bunch of research for installation during my kitchen remodel 2 years ago. The hood works well and, on the lowest setting, is very quiet, which is a big selling point for me. So, when I did my research this year, looking for a new dishwasher to replace the Kenmore Elite I had for 20 years, I naturally looked at KitchenAid again. I did compare it to comparable other makes of dishwashers, but the customer reviews for this one were almost all very positive, unlike what I read about the the other brands out there. And boy, were the KitchenAid customers right! The first time I ran this dishwasher, I actually opened it up twice to confirm that it was running - it's really that quiet! There is plenty of room for whatever you want to tuck into it and, if you use the top, 3rd shelf, for all your flatware and cooking utensils, you have even more room for dishes and pans because you can take out the utensils basket that normally sits in the lowest shelf. That basket is now living in my basement - I don't need it in this dishwasher. I LOVE the third, top shelf! And everything so far, comes out clean and sparkling - it washes like a dream. I talked this up so much among my friends that one friend came over and took pictures of it and my KitchenAid range hood so that she can order both for her upcoming kitchen remodeling job. Oh - and if you order this, get the towel rack instead of a recessed door handle - that towel rack is a very useful feature in a modern kitchen that often lacks a convenient place by the sink to hang a kitchen towel.

Sentence (English): My wife has always wanted to buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): My wife has always wanted to buy a dishwasher. Unfortunately, I didn’t expect to install a dishwasher when I was renovating it 5 years ago. I made an appointment with two dishwasher installers to come and measure the size. There is no way to install a large one, so I can only consider the countertop one. I ordered a wooden frame to pretend to be a dishwasher for the cabinet where the trash can was originally placed. Practice has proved that the dishwasher is not an IQ tax. It is a very good kitchen helper. It adds soft water salt and puts a three-in-one dishwashing block. The 29-minute quick dishwashing is also a brand-new volume. I am disappointed, the volume is a bit small, but it is enough for a family of 3, and it can be washed a few times at most. It takes 29 minutes to wash quickly, and it can generally be washed clean. If it is too dirty, you can choose 1.5 hours of standard washing and 1 hour of drying.
Comments (Original): 老婆一直想添置洗碗机，可惜5年前装修的时候没想到要装洗碗机，预约了两家洗碗机的安装师傅来上门量尺寸，没办法安装大的只能考虑台上的。原来放垃圾桶位置，订了个木架，假装是柜子的洗碗机。实践证明，洗碗机不是智商税，很好的厨房帮手，加了软水盐，放了三合一的洗碗块，29分钟的快速洗碗也是洗的崭新发量，美的这款也没有让我失望，容积小了点，但3口之家也够用，顶多多洗几次。29分钟快洗，一般都能洗干净，太脏的选1个半小时标准洗加1个小时的烘干也就可以了。

Sentence (English): Having owned a Bosch dishwasher previously, I bought this one without a second thought.
Comments (English): [ Old Bosch vs. New Bosch ] || ---------------- || Having owned a Bosch dishwasher previously, I bought this one without a second thought. After 2 months, I can say it has exceptional cleaning power. I am less pleased with the design of the loading racks, nothing I could have forseen when viewing it in the store. The upper right fold down rack has a break in it; why? It leaves less area to lay things down in like long utensils, etc. The old vesion of the bottom rack was better configured as well. I am now doing a Jenga puzzle strategy to fit in bowls, plates, etc. Also not a fan of the untesil basket. It's too fussy. Would prefer an open design. I did try folding the currrent basket sides down; no go. The utensils just fall over and out of the basket. Could have purchased the next model up with a 3rd rack but could not justify $300 price difference. Live and learn.

Sentence (English): I recently did a kitchen remodel, and purchased a Bosch 800 series dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I love my new Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I recently did a kitchen remodel, and purchased a Bosch 800 series dishwasher. I love it. It cleans the dishes perfectly, offers a variety of settings, and is super quiet when running. I especially appreciate having the little red light that shines on the floor to let me know that it's running; it's a great reminder that a wash is in progress, so the door isn't opened during that time. I don't have a problem with moisture inside after the dishes are done being washed; if I wait a little bit after the washing is done, the dishes are dry and no need to wipe off any condensation; the only 'wet' areas are in bottom of my coffee cups, and that has more to do with how I loaded them in the dishwasher. I would be comfortable recommending this dishwasher.
